articles.summary: - Breakthrough Therapy Designation granted to NXC-201 based on positive NEXICART-2 Phase 2 interim clinical results, presented at the American Society of Hematology (ASH) 2025 annual meeting - - Final data expected this year followed by planned BLA submission - LOS ANGELES, CA, Jan. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Immix Biopharma, Inc. ("ImmixBio", "Company", "We"
articles.title: Immix Biopharma Receives U.S. FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation for NXC-201
